fold_rule: Each test interval is evaluated from a clean strategy instance with only authorized earlier replay history. The center is a no-fit deterministic rule; each fold artifact still binds the exact source/config/seed, training cutoff, embargo, and clean-process declaration. No full-period scaler, selector, coefficient, or ensemble is carried into a fold.
future_required_bindings: six byte-distinct model/declaration artifact SHA-256 values
six fold return artifact SHA-256 values
exact source bundle, strategy, frozen config, risk policy, seed, and journal-head hashes
central fold, quarter, regime, role, sleeve, stability, and concentration evidence
purge_and_embargo: The strategy is unsupervised and uses no forward label. A one-calendar-day boundary embargo is nevertheless reserved before each test start; any future supervised pivot must additionally purge every overlapping forward label and document its exact horizon.
selection_rule: No fold is optional and no failed fold is discarded. Stitched chronological evidence can qualify only when all frozen development gates pass. A negative or unqualified series is recorded as evidence and cannot be submitted.
